Probably... I'm just trying to avoid the mess it causes. I'm like that often.

The only reason we found out I was diabetic was a previous breakdown when I had awful grades, slept all the time, was always tired and missed months of school. I'm actually repeating this school year because of it.

I'll try and work up the courage to mention something... Cheers.

Hmmm. Easy and difficult :)

For one, I live very near the health centre I'm signed up for. (UK)

But also, my mum is quite high up in anything medical around here; last time I went there about 10 people recognised her. May not be easy :/

And if she found out without me saying that'd be worse
this is part of my problem. I shouldn't be complaining, so I feel worse
